nodes.name: AdminBrandController.java
nodes.summary: Exposes administrative endpoints for creating, updating, and deleting brands. It delegates brand mutations to BrandService and wraps results in HTTP responses.

nodes.name: AdminBrandController
nodes.summary: REST controller for administrative brand mutations backed by BrandService.

nodes.name: createBrand
nodes.summary: Creates a brand from request data, generates a slug, persists it, and returns the response projection.

nodes.name: deleteBrandById
nodes.summary: Deletes a brand by id through the service or repository layer.

nodes.name: updateBrand
nodes.summary: Updates brand fields and regenerates the slug before returning the response projection.

nodes.name: AdminCategoryController.java
nodes.summary: Exposes administrative category endpoints for creation, updates, deletion, and image upload. It delegates category mutations and storage work to CategoryService.

nodes.name: AdminCategoryController
nodes.summary: REST controller for administrative category mutation and upload workflows backed by CategoryService.

nodes.name: createCategory
nodes.summary: Creates a category, resolves an optional parent, normalizes image metadata, generates a slug, and returns the response projection.

nodes.name: updateCategory
nodes.summary: Updates category fields, validates parent changes, cleans up replaced local images, and returns the response projection.

nodes.name: deleteCategoryById
nodes.summary: Deletes a category after guarding against child categories and linked products, then removes the local image when applicable.

nodes.name: uploadCategoryImage
nodes.summary: Stores an uploaded category image and returns the resulting URL.

nodes.name: BrandController.java
nodes.summary: Provides public brand lookup endpoints for paged listings and lookup by id, name, or slug. It is a thin REST controller over BrandService read operations.

nodes.name: BrandController
nodes.summary: Public REST controller for brand catalog read endpoints.

nodes.name: getAllBrands
nodes.summary: Returns a paged list of brand response projections.

nodes.name: getBrandById
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand by id and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getBrandByName
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand by exact name and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getBrandBySlug
nodes.summary: Looks up a brand by slug and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: CategoryController.java
nodes.summary: Provides public category lookup endpoints for paged listings, root categories, and lookup by id or name. It delegates read behavior to CategoryService.

nodes.name: CategoryController
nodes.summary: Public REST controller for category catalog and root category read endpoints.

nodes.name: getAllCategories
nodes.summary: Returns a paged list of category response projections.

nodes.name: getCategoryById
nodes.summary: Looks up a category by id and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getCategoryByName
nodes.summary: Looks up a category by exact name and returns its response projection.

nodes.name: getRootCategories
nodes.summary: Returns a paged list of categories with no parent.

nodes.name: BrandRequest.java
nodes.summary: Defines the compact request payload used when creating or updating a brand. The record currently carries the brand name only.

nodes.name: BrandRequest
nodes.summary: Record representing a brand mutation request.

nodes.name: CategoryRequest.java
nodes.summary: Defines the category mutation payload with name, optional parent id, and optional image URL. It supports both category hierarchy changes and image metadata updates.

nodes.name: CategoryRequest
nodes.summary: Record representing a category mutation request with hierarchy and image fields.

nodes.name: BrandResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the brand response projection returned by controllers and services. Its mapper converts Brand entities into id, name, and slug DTOs.

nodes.name: BrandResponse
nodes.summary: Record representing the serialized brand view returned by APIs.

nodes.name: fromEntity
nodes.summary: Converts a JPA entity into the corresponding API response record.

nodes.name: CategoryResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the category response projection with hierarchy and image fields. Its mapper flattens parent category identity while preserving public category metadata.

nodes.name: CategoryResponse
nodes.summary: Record representing the serialized category view returned by APIs.

nodes.name: fromEntity
nodes.summary: Converts a JPA entity into the corresponding API response record.

nodes.name: UploadUrlResponse.java
nodes.summary: Defines the response payload for upload operations that return a stored file URL. It is used by category image upload endpoints.

nodes.name: UploadUrlResponse
nodes.summary: Record representing a stored upload URL.
